points.point: Does the bakery Page's 20 posts block the catering Page (shared login)?
points.sentence: Each Page has its own independent 25-post limit, so posts to one Page do not count against another.

points.point: The 20 posts a day number against the limit
points.sentence: Facebook publishing is limited to 25 posts per 24 hours per Page.

points.point: Posting above 5 a day (the customer's Facebook 5 remark)
points.sentence: Posting above 5 per day per Page also negatively impacts post reach.

verdict.reason: This entry says the 25-post limit applies to each Page on its own and that posts to one Page don't count against another, so the bakery's 20 posts won't block the catering Page.
